demo.title: luckdrop-chat.txt
demo.code:
You:    enter me in the LuckDrop prize draw
Bankr:  Your wallet can enter the current draw. The ticket is free; you pay only Base gas.
        Send the entry transaction to the LuckDrop draw contract on Base? [Yes]
You:    yes
Bankr:  Entered (tx 0x...). Your ticket is in the draw.

- later -
You:    how is the draw going?
Bankr:  Round 3 of 5 is done. Your ticket is still in. Next round in a few hours.

You:    enter me in every draw from now on
Bankr:  Done. I will check every few hours and enter when a draw is open.

setup: In Bankr security settings, turn on "Enable arbitrary contract calls": entry is a direct call to the LuckDrop draw contract
Hold a little ETH on Base in your Bankr wallet for gas
Say "enter me in the LuckDrop prize draw", then "how is the draw going?", "claim my LuckDrop welcome grant" or "enter me in every draw"
